description: This file defines a UI component called 'Button' using the LightningJS framework. It specifies a template with dynamic content based on component state and handles input to toggle the 'favorited' state.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes the component's state with 'isFavorited', 'favoriteText', and 'unfavoriteText'.

methods.name: input.enter
methods.description: Handles the 'enter' input event by toggling the 'isFavorited' state.
